newsitem.title: UK: Sun Life H1 pretax profit 92.5 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Sun Life H1 pretax profit 92.5 mln stg.

text.p: NOTE - Sun Life & Provincial Holdings Plc, which was floated on the London Stock Exchange in June and is a unit of UAP, said it had prepared its figures for the period on a proforma basis, on the assumption that the current structures were in place throughout the six months to June 30.

NOTE - The group said the first dividend it intended to pay would be the final dividend for the 1996 financial year and it was not therefore declaring an interim. But had it declared an interim dividend based on the pro forma results, it would have been 3.34 pence per share net. This would normally represent approximately one-third of any expected total annual dividend, with the final dividend the other two-thirds.
